_doc: Bannerline economy + clock knobs. Read by js/sim/economy.js and tools/econ-sim.mjs. Times are seconds. Change a number here, re-run `node tools/econ-sim.mjs`, and check the verdict block before committing.

clock._doc: risingTide: from this second the match escalates every risingEvery s (step n = 1, 2, 3...): Tides jump risingTideLevels levels per step, leaks count x (risingLeakMult + risingLeakStep*(n-1)). This is the end clock: it guarantees a stronger defence eventually breaks.

field._doc: cap = live bodies per field; sends beyond it wait at the gate. econ-sim peak is ~31, so 60 is headroom, and the render budget (PLAN §15) is sized to it.

items._doc: Shop model the econ sim uses: 8 equipment slots, each upgraded through 7 steps (5 base tiers, then rare and legendary rolls of the top base). A step REPLACES the last, so dps/hp/armor are the gain over the previous step. Steps unlock by match time. The real shop (data/shop.json) prices bases + rarity from these. `unlock` no longer gates the shop (lead decision 2026-10-03: gold is the gate); it is the second from which drops and champion picks may roll that step.

hero._doc: Generic hero curve for the econ model; per-class numbers live in data/heroes.json. aoe = how much a crowd multiplies clear speed (1 + aoe * (min(bodies, 6) - 1) / 5).
